corrections.text: The article says of the October 15 comment about Google's CLA and the DCO change in pull request 3237 that "No cited source links the two." The pull request description says "Part of cncf/sandbox#542" (the Agent Substrate onboarding issue that CNCF automation opened on 2026-10-20) and "I have enabled DCO enforcement, and will shortly drop the Google CLA enforcement", so a cited source ties the DCO change to the project's CNCF onboarding, though not to the October 15 comment.

The article says "The cited sources do not say when the planned changes to gVisor's build infrastructure and governance will be complete." The CNCF automation comments on the three Sandbox issues (#521, #523 and #518) tell each project to "Complete onboarding within one month of acceptance"; none of the cited sources says whether that target covers the build infrastructure and governance changes described by The New Stack.
